    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_arm2

    Zigzags with a fork and an arm at a source: BO13a figure 5.4 #

    The diagram: two forks out of x p; the zigzag ρ (p+j), σ (p+j) (j ≤ L) ending at the source x (p+L+1); r : x (p+L+1) → M; and two leaves at M: v : X'' → M and s'' : M → E. It is an orientation of D̃₂ₗ₊₇ (RayCat.ZB).
